args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion.

- Pellow Home Living (Mid-Atlantic home goods retailer) was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- "PHL" now points to two customers: Pellow Home Living and Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast port/terminal). Filtering "PHL" in the morning report returns rows for both.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", and that the old label was making the receiving supervisor search twice. The report-label change was added to the handoff list. We haven't confirmed whether it has been fixed since.
- Related ticket: PD-4821 (Pellow door 6 / Tuesday maintenance block), cited in the same digest.
- Until this is cleaned up, we check the org ID before bulk audits.

Ask: please relabel the saved report to "Pellow Home Living — Late Arrivals", and stop using the bare "PHL" code for either account.

Thanks,
Bettina
